source: IS 456:2000 Clause 33: the effective spans (33.1), stairs built into walls and open wells (33.2), the depth of section (33.3) are the same rules as the parent's; the special stairs (free-standing, sawtooth, helicoidal) stay the parent's (IS 456 has no method for them). Entered from knowledge of the code (VERIFY.md of the pack).

sources.builtIn: IS 456:2000 33.2: flights or landings embedded at least 110 mm into walls and spanning along the flight: a 150 mm strip deducted from the loaded area, the effective breadth increased by 75 mm
sources.openWellShare: IS 456:2000 33.2: open wells, the load on areas common to two crossing spans one half in each direction
